findings.label: ON UPDATE CASCADE vs doc example
findings.detail: Composite FKs use ON UPDATE CASCADE while docs/tenancy.md §4 example omits ON UPDATE. Harmless because id/institutionId are immutable cuids that never update; the cascade never fires. No action required; noted for the record.

findings.label: Escape suite is a live-DB suite inside the default vitest glob
findings.detail: tenant-escape.integration.test.ts requires network + campass_app credentials, so a CI run of `vitest run` without DB access would fail it. The plan flags this as a later CI-tagging follow-up; B-1 intentionally does not alter CI wiring. Track for B-2/CI.
